annotations.title: SEC Form TCR & PSLRA Forensic Dossier Engine

description: Computes the 8-variable Beneish M-Score, first-digit Benford Chi-Square statistic, Halliburton II event-study t-statistic, Dodd-Frank § 922 (10%-30%) SEC Whistleblower bounty projection, and PSLRA litigation syndicate recovery model for a public issuer. Use when: a litigation finance fund, securities class-action counsel, or whistleblower syndicate requires quantitative accounting anomaly and event-study verification under 17 CFR § 240.21F-4(b)(3). Do not use when: pricing standard fixed-income CUSIP bonds or running macro interest rate stress tests (use get_cusip_valuation or run_portfolio_stress_test instead). Behavior: Read-only, deterministic quantitative forensic calculation with zero external side effects.
